identity.name: Office Process Spawning Suspicious One-Liner
identity.summary: An attacker uses Microsoft Word to execute a PowerShell command via a one-liner that downloads and runs a malicious payload from a remote C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as a suspicious proces
identity.description: An attacker uses Microsoft Word to execute a PowerShell command via a one-liner that downloads and runs a malicious payload from a remote C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as a suspicious process spawning pattern.

biocs.name: Microsoft Office Process Spawning PowerShell with Suspicious One-Liner
biocs.description: Detection of winword.exe or excel.exe spawning powershell.exe with a suspicious command-line pattern
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'winword.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'excel.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'IEX' or action_command_line contains 'DownloadString'
| filter action_command_line contains '192.0.2.50'
